description:
Safety check for any Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint before an agent or app interacts with it. SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER with a 0-100 score, from mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions that can block or tax sells, liquidity and recent sells, holder concentration and age. Free preview tier: verdict, score and flag counts. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005) and /v1/check ($0.02) add the reasons and evidence. SAFE is not a guarantee and not financial advice.

[SolVerdict via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as SolVerdict's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 / check $0.02 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.005, check $0.02. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
